o.norm: Output array is not large enough to accommodate decoded data.

i.norm: decodeHex(char[], out, outOffset) needs (data.length / 2) bytes of room in {@code out}, starting at {@code outOffset}. Here the 6 hex chars require 3 output bytes, but the offset (1589) starts far beyond the end of the 7-byte output array, leaving no space. The method must reject this with a DecoderException complaining that the output array is too small.
Output array is not large enough to accommodate decoded data.
